title: Ask toward an open problem: The Collatz (3x+1) conjecture
statement: Propose five candidate un-asked questions, each smaller than the open problem below and each such that its answer would bear on it. Problem OP-MATH-COLLATZ: Does iterating n -> n/2 for even n and n -> 3n+1 for odd n reach 1 from every positive integer? Each candidate must pass the Depth requirement of LEDGER.md, must not be a duplicate of ledger/INDEX.md, must not be the problem itself or a known reformulation of it, and must carry a bears_on link to OP-MATH-COLLATZ saying how its answer would bear on the problem.
